title: How Deeply a Client has Funded its Micro Market, and What that Moves on the Share
content:
A step is added to or taken off the share applied to a kiosk trip at an Unattended Micro Market Program market according to how many subsidy lots the client has funded over the trailing year and how much funding stands unspent on the agreement.

## Points of judgement

**When is a step added?** Where the client funded 4 or more subsidy lots over the twelve months to the day the discount is worked out, and the funding standing unspent on the agreement is at or above the minimum funding lot printed against the market format, the deep-funding step of 2.5 percentage points is added to the share.

**When is a step taken off?** Where the client funded 1 or fewer subsidy lots over those twelve months, or the funding standing unspent on the agreement is below the minimum funding lot printed against the market format, the thin-funding step of 4 percentage points is taken off the share. Either limb on its own is enough.

**And otherwise?** Where neither of those holds, nothing is added to or taken off the share.

## The boundaries in figures

The deep-funding lot count is 4: a year carrying exactly 4 lots meets it, and a year carrying 3 does not. The thin-funding lot count is 1: a year carrying 1 lot or none meets it, and a year carrying 2 does not. The comparison of the unspent funding is made against the minimum funding lot printed against the market format, funding standing exactly at that figure counting as at or above it.

## Hypothetical readings

A client funding 5 lots over the trailing twelve months, with unspent funding of 9000 USD against a printed minimum funding lot of 8500 USD, has 2.5 percentage points added to the share.

A client funding 5 lots over the same period, but with only 400 USD standing unspent against that same printed minimum, meets the second limb of the second condition and has 4 percentage points taken off the share.

A client funding 2 lots, with unspent funding at or above the printed minimum, has nothing added or taken off.
